204.description: Shipment confirmed (or the order was already `CONFIRMED`).

Idempotency-Replayed.description: Present, with the value `true`, only when this answer is a replay of the stored answer for the same `Idempotency-Key`.

400.description: The `Idempotency-Key` header is missing (`idempotency-key-required`) or not 1-128 printable ASCII characters (`idempotency-key-invalid`; also when the header is repeated), or the request body could not be read or contains a NUL character (`malformed-request-body`), or the query string contains a NUL character (`invalid-request`).

example.title: Idempotency-Key header is required
example.detail: the Idempotency-Key header is required on this operation

404.description: No network order with that `networkRef` (`network-order-not-found`), or a path that carries a NUL character (`resource-not-found`).

409.description: The order is not `ACKNOWLEDGED`, so shipment cannot be confirmed yet (`confirm-before-acknowledge`). A shipment may not be confirmed for an order we never committed to. Also the answer when the `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different request (method, path or body): problem type `idempotency-key-reused`, a client bug, not to be retried. Or a request with the same key is still in flight after the server waited 30 seconds for it (`idempotency-key-in-progress`): retry later with the same key. Finally `version-conflict`: another writer (the demand poller or a sweep) changed the order between this request's load and its save — retryable after a reload.

500.description: Unexpected error, including a failed submission to the network AFTER the order was already saved as `CONFIRMED`; a retry then returns 204 without re-submitting.
